# FUNCTIONAL_R4_CA12

Sealed synthetic replacement holdout for the CA-12 component comparison. The
archive contains 16 files and 10 fixed queries/judgments; only the evaluation
steward may decrypt it with the key kept outside Git in the canonical audit
directory. The ablation runner must execute exactly `full`, `no_expansion`,
`no_semantic` and `no_catalog` in isolated workspaces and emit aggregate-only
results. This reserve is not for tuning after freeze or after any aggregate is
disclosed.
